reviews.author: Doug King (TheWolfDJT)
reviews.text: I always have great service, every time I go in I get it taken care of, they start what they're doing just to get to my vehicle, everyone was exceptional and very nice, they also had someone new, I think I over Heard his name being Jake, he was doing a great job of everything that he was doing.

reviews.author: Tyler Clowe
reviews.text: Great experience! I had a lot of issues with my car out of nowhere and was having trouble getting answers from a couple other mechanics. Eventually ended up at Ford Brothers, they had a diagnosis by end of day and fixed it by the next business day. Kind, honest folks with a lot of knowledge and fair prices. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dawn Mcilvain
reviews.text: The ladies and gentlemen there are just wonderful,fast,through and I highly recommend these folks if you are in need of car repairs,tires,oil changes basically any thing you need for your car maintenance !! Give them a call you'll be glad you did !! Just as a note if you may not have the money to spend at that moment the also offer Snap finance which helps tremendously and it can break your owed money down into payments (if you qualify).

reviews.author: Nicholas Roberts
reviews.text: Great people to work with. Amazing prices on tires too! Prices can’t be beat! Chuck was very professional and polite. Saved me over $1,000 bucks on 2 sets of tires. He has earned my business for life.

reviews.author: Chance Chandler
reviews.text: I've had the pleasure of dealing with Ford Brothers a while now. I've never had an issue with their work and I know I'm getting quality parts and the warranties cannot be beat. Parts fail sometimes even when they are new and I've had that happen once they covered everything. I trust them 100 percent with all of my vehicle needs. They also offer the best rates on labor. Very courteous, helpful, and professional they go over ever detail with you from beginning to completion of service. I just had one of my vehicles repaired and I'm pleased as I always am. I am glad they are a part of the community as well...I like dealing with hometown folk and people who give back to the community!

reviews.author: Johnathan Pumphrey
reviews.text: I stopped in to do a pre purchase inspection and they were just flat out awesome. They did exactly what I needed and had great snacks while we waited and was very patient with us even though we were late. The cost per hour was great and the results I got was dead on. If your looking for a place to get work done or a car checked out stop on by you get what you need done. Also we got girls scout cookies while waiting and it seems they support them so we had to aswell.

reviews.author: Dimitry Olshansky
reviews.text: New to the area and I do not recommend this place. Still have issues with my car after 2 visits, ridiculous prices, they don’t test drive your car before giving it back. Didn’t even put air an the spare wheel after replacing tires, oil was on empty after I told them to do full check up on my car the bill was half of the car value how about that after putting new brakes and changing tires. Plus they will lie and tell you that you have bunch of other issues that need to be fixed just to rip you off and get as much money as they possibly can from you. Stay away from this place!!!

reviews.author: wanda Bennett
reviews.text: Don’t ever take your car to them. They are rude and they didn’t even fix my car..cost almost $1000 for the AC compressor and it still doesn’t work. The guy in front is rude and I don’t know why anybody would go up there and he did the same thing to a friend of mine. . The lady that works up there with him she’s nice., there are not words to say how rude he is..

reviews.author: Daniel King
reviews.text: They are rude and very un professional and charged 876.00 for balljoints. When i picked my truck up there was a big cut in the head liner called dude he said we didnt do it when clearly ik it wasnt like that when i dropped it off

reviews.author: Amasia Singletary
reviews.text: Always friendly and great quality work. I've been going to these guys for 2 years, commuting 40 minutes because I trust them to do the job and do it right. They've never tried to upsell me a product I did not need. Trustworthy reliable mechanics.

reviews.author: Clove C
reviews.text: Chuck and his staff are 1st rate. My father uses them and they treated me great and repair my car quick. My Father was right, These are some people you can trust and David was Amazing also

reviews.author: jen timmermans
reviews.text: Went because heard good things. I am so glad I did. The counter guy was great. The mechanic called me explained the part I needed and why, took the time to answer all my questions I was impressed the guy that was repairing my car called me not someone else that is a great way of doing things. The costs were lower than other shops I know I called around a little. I will not go anywhere else now. Thanks Ford Brothers

reviews.author: gaynelle winstead
reviews.text: We use to have no problems with this shop but I believe the problem is the manager and not the owner …but after selling us new tires when we didn’t need them …they sawed off a bolt and it became lodged between the rotor and cap which caused the truck to lock up. Fortunately we were going slow otherwise it could have been a nasty accident. Who with any morals would let someone leave the shop knowing it was an unsafe vehicle .They would not take any responsibility after numerous times going back to the shop and calls the owner still has never called. The mgr is very condescending and unprofessional.

reviews.author: Rick Green
reviews.text: I had some work done on my vehicles at Ford Brothers Auto Repair in the past and was satisfied. Today I looked up Ford Brothers Auto Repair online and the online site indicated the shop was open. I called to make an appointment for repair on one of my vehicles. The gentleman that answered the phone yelled into the phone "It's posted all over Facebook that we are closed due to a funeral!". I told him I'm sorry to hear that and I don't have a Facebook account. In my mind maybe they should have set up their voicemail on their phone to inform calling customers of their situation.

reviews.author: Cody Gunter
reviews.text: The worst experience ever. Truck was there for 5 days and not even touched. Owner wanted to charge for work not done. When I tried to pay and just take truck to a better place they refused to take payment and hold truck hostage and ended up calling Roxboro PD. I would NOT recommend this place to anyone….unless you need an inspection without having your vehicle checked out. I did witness that bappen today for several different vehicles while tryin to get my truck

reviews.author: Jenna Thurlow
reviews.text: Back in December I brought my vehicle to Ford brothers, I’m new to the area and a few people had recommended them, plus they could fit me in. I knew I needed my wheel bearings replaced so they told me I needed them all around and proceeded to start with the back, I thought it was only the front but I’m not a mechanic. I had done some research and found out journeys go through bearings so I didn’t think anything of it. When I went to pick up my vehicle, the mechanic who did the work, Matt, came and spoke with me and insisted I also needed new brakes, I insisted that was not right as my brakes were not even a year old yet and I don’t drive that much. Now I couldn’t afford to replace all the bearings so I had to wait on the front and I knew they needed to be done because my car sounded the same as when I dropped it off. I found someone else to take care of one of the bearings and another mechanic took care of the driver side. Both mechanics said my brakes looked BRAND NEW!!! Matt was lying through his teeth and now I’m questioning whether he did any work on my car at all. Now that my front bearings are done I can now hear noise coming from the back. I will never recommend this place to anyone, go to anyone else if you want honest work done on your vehicle!

reviews.author: Lincoln Williams
reviews.text: A++ First of all the ladies at the front desk are super nice and take care of their customers very quick. Even though I had no appointment, my inspection was done very fast. I recommend Ford Brothers to everyone.

reviews.author: Myra Shockley
reviews.text: I called to ask some questions, asked to speak to the owner, and the male who answered the call asked for my name, and what the call was concerning. Then asked my phone number, and asked me more info on my reason for calling.( I was asked by a friend to call and ask if they owned a used car lot beside them, she was interested in a used car that she thought was located in a lot beside them. )Well the male I spoke with never would let me speak to the person I asked to speak with, was gruff about putting me on hold before he would answer any more of my questions, so I hung up. I didn't want to talk to him, but to the person I asked for. And I found him quite rude about it all except for the fact that he was dealing with someone else before I called. I know I'm not the only person in the world, or the only customer this day. But the incredible anger and disgust in his voice when he asked me to hold on, instead of connecting me with the person I asked to speak with, made me feel very unvalued as a customer, and the friend that asked me to call, and I have definitely agreed this was rude, disgusting, and not a company that is caring or patient, or understanding, and definitely not one we want to trust with our business ever!

reviews.author: Perry Jennings
reviews.text: Bought 4 tires at a good price. They did my alignment and was told I needed a upper control arm. They put the wrong side on. They also did not put all my bolts and rubber boots and bushens back I had to take it some where else to fix and redo another alignment.

reviews.author: Elizabeth G Powell
reviews.text: Locally owned and operated. Great staff with quality service. They are trustworthy and honest about the work that is needed, what can be done and what gets done. A big plus: they do not try to get over on women which is a big deal these days.

reviews.author: James j Crawley
reviews.text: Ford Bros. On main Street are trust worthy and they give you a comfort level when you leave your vehicle for repairs that you know that the job is going to be done right ! The prices are not outrageous. Good job ! I'll be back ! Nice staff also.

reviews.author: savannah smith
reviews.text: They were super informative, and let me know step by step what was needed to be done. Very reasonable and interested in helping genuinely, not just for money!! Recommended for everyone. Plus the work warranty is hard to beat!

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.text: Tires are cheap but you get what you pay for!! Wheels weights popped off in less than 4000 miles and they want to charge to replace them. Even though they charge you to mount and balance the first time. Not on my most recommended list for auto or tire shops in Roxboro.

reviews.author: Bryant Parson
reviews.text: My family tried to use this repair shop and found it nearly impossible to get anything done. They won't make appointments, their scheduling is disorganized, they are unfriendly and unprofessional. Even when we tried to follow their procedure and did everything they told us to, they still were very rude and totally unhelpful. I don't know if it's under new management, because they seem to have some good reviews here, but I don't know how they are still in business based on my experience.

reviews.author: rex noblin
reviews.text: Tires were a great price but they can't be dependable on when they will put them on. They will tell you one time and after you drive there they will say sorry we can't do it today come back tomorrow. Not a good way to do business!

reviews.author: Kevin Duncan
reviews.text: Had a vehicle inspection. Was pretty quick. Friendly staff. And Always feel like no matter what you're having done. They appreciate your business

reviews.author: paul shields
reviews.text: perry jenning, did on 11/12/19 tie rod and sleeve, never did or mentioned needing control arm, never called or came back we tell all customers have an issue bring it back so we can check it, Listen folks we are humans we make mistakes like everyone, we wish we did not thou same as everyone. michael pinto ( tony) 3/6/19 did tires customer 1 month ago puts a 2 star rating, now is this because he works for olive hill and they feel we should do free alignments on there work trucks for free forever....???? who knows we get this 2 star rating, small business are suppose to support help each other I know they enjoyed making over 10000.00 installing our lift. ryan graves a month ago puts a 1 star rating , we never have had a customer by that name, we get mixed in with the other Ford Place In Town Alot As They Do Us. Myra Shockley called in when I had 3 customers at the counter asking if the empty lot a few properties up the road, what did we know about it, we nicely explained very busy have no knowledge of who owns, hence we get a negative rating, never met her yet she casts this negativity on a place she has never done business with. Folks Ford Brothers Auto Repair does alot for our community, we love our community, We wish we never made an error, but being humans it will happen from time to time we are open and honest.

reviews.author: Christy D.
reviews.text: Honest and fair aren't something you can always say about a auto shop. This one I can say both. They quoted us a price better than several other places that we called. Stuck to it and fixed everything just as quoted. I will definitely be going back for oil changes or anything else that might come up.

reviews.author: Joseph Renn
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! Highly recommend for all your mechanical needs. Unbeatable tire sales also. Best prices in town!

reviews.author: Ryan Graves
reviews.text: Told me my engine was blowed and couldnt be repaired..said it would cost me $3000 for a new engine..from just asking the mechanic a few questions i could tell he didn't kno what he was talking about....long story short, took my car home and repaired it for $300..runs like new..just wonder how many people with less knowledge about cars have been taking advantage of at this place

reviews.author: Melinda Stone
reviews.text: Very good services, in a timely matter. Affordable prices and friendly staff. Will likely return in for future needs.

reviews.author: lew austin
reviews.text: Rude leadership will sink a good ship, WILL NOT BE DOING ANY BUSINESS WITH FORD BROTHERS. Plenty of real costumer friendly shops in town, Strut Daddy’s for one.

reviews.author: Raina S Agradable
reviews.text: Took my car there to have the brake pads and rotors replaced and had the tie rods and ball joints checked May of this year so they claimed that the tie rods and ball joints were ok but need to be replaced later on so they supposedly replaced the brake pads and rotors everything came to $749 around the first 2 weeks in June the tie rods and ball joints messed up the brakes started squeaking loudly and made a loud grinding sound so I borrowed my brother’s car and went to them and told them what was going on with the car and they anxiously said are you going to leave the car with us and I said well I will let you know called them and priced tie rods and ball joints and they said it would be $1500 they ripped me off and got $749 free but they won’t get $1500 out me now I have to take my car to another mechanic to actually fix what they lied about fixing.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.text: Great people good customer service go above and beyond. Chuck's and the staff are always helpful and pleasant

reviews.author: chris baxter
reviews.text: Was taken care of very professional, knowledgeable staff. Great automotive technicians are knowledgeable and detaile oriented. Appreciate you all .

reviews.author: Dmytro Shalaliyev
reviews.text: This place is a rip off!! I will never bring my car to ford brothers again, - if you going to charge so much money at leas fix the issue.

reviews.author: Smith Insulation
reviews.text: Helped us out in a pinch. Very friendly and professional. We appreciate your help. Will use again in the future

reviews.author: Clayton Jolly
reviews.text: Did not put my wife's tires on right and did not put my lug nuts on all the way so my tire was coming off as I was going down the road then when I called and asked about it he told me it was because of the mileage on my truck. I was highly disappointed

reviews.author: Dennis Kradel
reviews.text: They did a good job fixing the A/C in my Jeep and they were up front about everything they did and how much it would cost.

reviews.author: K Brown
reviews.text: I went for an oil change they told me it was an 20-30 minutes wait. I waited an hour. I went back to ask was they going to change my oil I was told I had to wait an extra 20-30 minutes on top of the hour I waited. This is not acceptable. BAD BUSINESS

reviews.author: Lori Durham
reviews.text: Take my old Hyundai Accent there anytime there are problems and the mechanics are very knowledgeable and very fair priced.

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text: We had oil leaking from our van after an oil change there the day before. My wife had to spend 2 hours returning to Ford Bro. and waiting for them to find that the oil seal on the filter hadn't been properly put on. They could have at least offered something for the trouble, but nothing. Considering it could have ruined the engine had we not noticed it they could have at least refunded the oil change charge.
